n8n_automation.title: n8n Email Automation Send
n8n_automation.description: Automated system to send personalized job applications and CVs using n8n workflows.
n8n_automation.longDescription: A robust end-to-end automated pipeline created with n8n to send tailored job applications and outreach emails. It reads recipient data, extracts dynamic attachments, and customizes email copies per recipient while preventing spam folder delivery with automated verification and logging.
features: End-to-end automation workflow built on n8n
Dynamic email content & CV attachment customization per recipient
Automated retry mechanisms and error handling for failed deliveries
Comprehensive logging and execution metrics dashboard

route_finder.title: Smart Route Finder in Networks
route_finder.description: Python-based pathfinding application designed to calculate and visualize the smartest and most optimal routing paths within network topologies.
route_finder.longDescription: An interactive Python network routing simulation tool designed to test, visualize, and benchmark pathfinding algorithms across complex distributed networks. Implements Dijkstra's algorithm and QoS routing to determine optimal latency and bandwidth-efficient routes.
features: Interactive graph visualization of network nodes and topologies
Real-time Dijkstra and QoS shortest-path computation
Node failure simulation and dynamic re-routing adaptation
Packet metrics, latency analysis, and throughput tracking

dental_clinic.title: Dental Clinic Database System
dental_clinic.description: A comprehensive database management system designed in C# for dental clinics to manage patient records, appointments, and treatment history.
dental_clinic.longDescription: A full-featured desktop management system tailored for dental clinics and practices. Empowers dentists and administrative staff to manage patient histories, appointment calendars, treatment sessions with an interactive odontogram dental chart, and billing operations.
features: Interactive dental chart (Odontogram) for clinical procedures and fillings
Complete patient records, medical history, and treatment logs
Smart appointment scheduling, reminders, and invoicing system
Secure Microsoft SQL Server database with automated backups

computer_science.title: OSSU Computer Science Curriculum
computer_science.description: A complete curriculum path for a self-taught B.Sc. level education in Computer Science using free online university courses.
computer_science.longDescription: A structured academic repository documenting the comprehensive self-taught Computer Science degree curriculum following OSSU standards. Covers algorithms, discrete mathematics, system design, computer architecture, and distributed systems with documented code implementations.
features: Full curriculum path covering core computer science disciplines

Systematic references for technical software engineering interviews
